steps.en: PLUS submits the suspension request and OCMS checks the required fields
steps.id: PLUS mengirim permintaan suspension dan OCMS mengecek isian wajibnya

steps.en: The unpaid notice is permanently suspended in the database
steps.id: Notice unpaid berhasil di-permanent-suspend di database

steps.en: PLUS receives a message that the permanent suspension succeeded
steps.id: PLUS menerima pesan bahwa permanent suspension berhasil
